Lina (Finance): FYI: small set of updates to vendor payment SLAs and preferred vendor handling, effective Mon Jul 12. See short memo: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/Preferred+Vendors+and+Payment+SLAs :memo:

Marco (Eng): What's the change to payment SLA? We had a vendor pause last week and it blocked a deploy.

Lina (Finance): Primary change: standard vendor invoices will be paid Net30 as before, but invoices submitted with complete PO + COI (if required) will be prioritized to Net15. Also were adding a "preferred vendor" queue for vendors we have standing agreements with 1 that pushes them to top of the AP batch.

Ellen (Sales Ops): How does a vendor get classified as preferred?

Lina (Finance): Criteria: recurring work > $25k/year, signed Master Services Agreement, and completed vendor risk assessment. Preferred vendors also get a single-point contact and predictable billing cadence. Submit a request via the procurement ticket with tag "preferred-nominate".

Sasha (Accounting): Small operational note: to get Net15, vendor invoices must include PO#, vendor remit email, and ACH/wiring details in the invoice PDF. Missing fields = Net30 default. We'll send a checklist template you can attach.

vendor-bot: procurement ticket created: FIN-2026-9999 by Marco (Eng) 1 status: awaiting finance intake.

Marco (Eng): I submitted FIN-2026-9999 for the infra monitoring vendor. They're recurring, about $30k/yr. Will the preferred path speed onboarding?

Lina (Finance): If you attach the signed MSA and vendor risk answers we can fast-track to preferred review. Preferred review SLA is 5 business days. If it's launch-critical, tag the ticket [LAUNCH-PRIORITY] and include Eng + PM approvals.

Ellen (Sales Ops): Any changes to PCard use? We use cards for ad-hoc partner spend sometimes.

Lina (Finance): PCard rules unchanged for now, but note: PCard cannot be used to pay vendors who require a PO or COI. For transactions > $4k tied to a vendor relationship, use procurement ticket so we can align GL and vendor terms.

Sasha (Accounting): Quick reminder on remittance: send invoices to ap@redwood.com and put the PO# in the email subject. If an invoice is submitted without a PO and AP has to create one, payment timing may shift to next cycle.

Marco (Eng): If Legal needs to redline the MSA, does that push us out of preferred eligibility?

Lina (Finance): Redlines are fine; they just extend timelines. Preferred status requires an executed agreement. If Legal negotiation is ongoing, mark the ticket and we'll keep it in expedited review until signed.

Sasha (Accounting): We'll publish a weekly preferred-vendor digest listing nominees and their current review status. Teams can watch the digest and ping the thread if they need a status update.

Marco (Eng): Awesome. I'll attach MSA and ask vendor for ACH info.

Lina (Finance): TL;DR: Net15 for complete invoices, preferred vendor queue for recurring signed vendors >$25k/yr, nominate via ticket with "preferred-nominate", launch exceptions via [LAUNCH-PRIORITY]. Full details + checklist: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/Preferred+Vendors+and+Payment+SLAs :white_check_mark:

Ellen (Sales Ops): :thumbsup: adding to our Ops playbook.

Sasha (Accounting): I'll attach the invoice checklist to the procurement form now.
